key.name: idle-timeout-seconds
key.summary: Idle timeout before the slideshow starts
key.description: Seconds of user inactivity after which the fullscreen slideshow starts (brief section 3, point 1).

key.name: lock-grace-period-seconds
key.description: If the first input after the slideshow starts arrives within this many seconds of the slideshow starting, the session is NOT locked. The comparison is a strict less-than (D16): a value of 0 means every input locks, since no elapsed time can be less than zero.

key.name: picture-folder
key.description: Absolute path to the folder the slideshow reads images from. An empty string (the default) means: the XDG pictures directory itself (D25), read recursively. A missing folder is not an error; the service logs it and keeps running (brief 3.7).

key.name: slide-interval-seconds
key.description: Seconds each image is shown before advancing to the next one. From 1 second (00:00:01) to 23:59:59 (86399 seconds); zero and a full day (86400) are not valid. The settings window has one slider in four equal quarters, 36 steps in all: every second from 1 to 10, every 5 seconds from 10 to 60, then 2, 3, 5, 10, 15, 20, 30, 45 and 60 minutes, then 2, 3, 4, 6, 8 and 12 hours, and the end of the slider, 23:59:59. A stored value between two steps is not changed by opening the window.

key.name: order
key.description: Random order, or alphabetical by file name.

key.name: scaling
key.description: "fill" crops the image to fill the screen; "fit" shows the whole image letterboxed. "fill" is the default and it costs picture: a 3:4 portrait picture on a 16:9 monitor shows 42 % of the picture, a 9:16 phone photo 32 %; a 3:2 landscape picture shows 84 %, 4:3 75 %. Whether "fill" is the right default is an open decision; "fit" is the one-line alternative (change the default of this key).

key.name: pan-portrait-images
key.description: When true and the scaling mode is "fill", a portrait picture on a landscape monitor is scrolled slowly from top to bottom while it is shown, instead of being cropped to its middle. The default is false on purpose: the animation redraws every frame, so it costs battery. The default only changes after a battery measurement on the reference laptop (docs/measurements/pan-battery-protocol.md).

key.name: show-screenshots
key.description: When false (the default) the slideshow leaves screenshots out: a folder named like a screenshot folder (Screenshots, and its translation in the language of the desktop, such as Képernyőképek in Hungarian) is not read, and neither is a picture whose file name starts like a screenshot's (Screenshot from ..., Screenshot_..., Képernyőkép ...). Only the names are looked at, never what a link points to. A picture folder chosen on purpose is not emptied by it: if the folder itself (or one above it) is a screenshot folder, nothing in it is left out. The sample pictures folder (sakkmesterke) is never touched. When true, nothing is left out.

key.name: first-run-done
key.summary: The settings window was opened once at login
key.description: Set to true by the login start (slideshowlock autostart) when it opens the settings window for the first time: it opens the window only while this is false and no picture folder has been chosen, so that it appears once, even if it is closed without choosing a folder. Not shown in the settings window.

key.name: transitions
key.description: How one picture changes into the next, as a list of names. The names are crossfade, fade-black, slide-in, push, ken-burns, zoom, wipe, circle, blur and rotate; with several names, "transition-order" says how one is chosen for each change. An empty list means no transition: the pictures change at once. How long a transition takes is "transition-duration", cut to half of the slide interval; there is none when the desktop's animations are off. On software rendering the blur is drawn as a cross fade, and so is Ken Burns on a picture that does not fill the window. The default is Ken Burns alone. A name that is not in the list above is ignored (and logged once), so a value written by another version never stops the slideshow. A schema key of this type cannot list its choices, so the program checks the names.

key.name: transition-order
key.summary: How a transition is chosen from several
key.description: With more than one name in "transitions": "random" picks one for each change, never the one just used; "sequence" goes through them in the order of the list above, round and round.

key.name: transition-duration
key.description: Seconds a transition takes, the same for every transition, from 0.2 to 5.0. The slideshow never lets a transition take more than half of the slide interval (a shorter time is used then, the stored value is not changed), and a transition that would be shorter than 0.2 seconds is not drawn: the picture changes at once.
